---
title: "Popularity of the Name Andrew"
author: "Andrew Lucas"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

# Read the extracted data for the name Andrew
andrew_data <- read_csv("Andrew.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Male Andrews Over the Years

```{r}
#| label: male-andrews-plot
# Filter for male Andrews and plot counts over time
andrew_data |>
  filter(sex == "M") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n)) +
  geom_line(color = "#1f78b4", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Popularity of the Name Andrew (Males)",
    subtitle = "Number of baby boys named Andrew per year in the US (1880–2025)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Female Andrews

```{r}
#| label: female-andrews-plot
# Filter for female Andrews and plot counts over time
andrew_data |>
  filter(sex == "F") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n)) +
  geom_line(color = "#e7298a", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Yes there are female andrews too",
    subtitle = "Counts rarely exceeded double digits, but they exist!",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
